body:
### Client product development

Delivered cross-platform features with React, React Native, and Node, working with clients on product discovery, API design, and delivery. Much of this work involved internal tools or projects that did not launch publicly.

### Stareworthy

[Stareworthy](https://www.stareworthy.com/) is a public-facing client project I worked on at Code + Trust. It offers personalized photo books for families.
